Deepak B R

📞 +91 89712 33792 • 📧 brdeepak12@gmail.com
🌐 Bangalore, India • 11+ years of software development experience

Professional Summary

11+ years of experience in software development, specializing in Core Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and backend systems.

Hands-on experience with REST APIs, Oracle SQL, Cassandra, JavaScript, and Shell scripting.

Experienced in both monolithic and microservices architecture, including OBPM migration projects.

Proficient in SDLC, STLC, code reviews, and Agile tools like Jira and Confluence.

Skilled in automation testing using Selenium and Cucumber.

Well-versed with tools: Jenkins, OpenShift, WebLogic, Bitbucket, Maven, Gradle.

Strong domain knowledge in Banking, Payments, and OBPM architecture.

Technical Skills

Technology Area Tools / Technologies Programming Core Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Databases Oracle SQL, Postgres, Cassandra Web Technologies JavaScript, HTML, XML Tools & DevOps Git, Bitbucket, Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, OpenShift Servers WebLogic Testing JUnit,Integration, Selenium, Cucumber OS / Scripting Linux, Shell Script Modeling Star UML (Sequence, Class Diagrams) Project Management Jira, Confluence

Professional Experience



Oracle India Pvt. Ltd. — Senior Developer

📅 Nov 2022 – Present
Project: Oracle Banking Payments (OBPM)

Developed microservices using Spring Boot and Java for OBPM.

Worked on migration from monolithic to microservices architecture.

Involved in Jenkins build and WebLogic deployment process.

Database interactions using Oracle SQL Developer.

Contributed to payment services: India, SEPA, Cross-border.

Guided team members and helped resolve technical challenges.

Performed automation testing using Selenium Framework.

Standard Chartered Bank — Developer

📅 May 2019 – Nov 2022
Project: Creditmate

Developed services using Spring Boot, Microservices, Spring Security.

Integrated backend with large XML, JSON, PDF data payloads.

Used Openshift and Jenkins for CI/CD deployments.

Performed JUnit and integration testing.

Hands-on with Selenium automation testing.

L&T Technology Services — Senior Engineer

📅 Nov 2016 – Apr 2019
Project: Master Control Station (DRDO)

Developed backend with Java, Spring Boot, and Cassandra.

Created frontend using AngularJS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript.

Implemented socket communication, multithreading, and collections.

Authored SRS, DDD, and worked directly with DRDO scientists.

Worked on system integration and REST API testing.

Concur Technologies (SAP) — Technical Consultant

📅 Mar 2014 – Oct 2016
Project: American Express Global Business Travel

Worked on Concur travel tools related to PNR and ticketing.

Backend development using Core Java and Spring Boot.

Used Oracle SQL Developer for database operations.



Education

B.E. in Information Science, East Point College of Engineering & Technology (VTU) — First Class

PUC, Seshadripuram PU College — First Class

SSLC, Maruthi Vidya Kendra — First Class

Personal Details

Date of Birth: 12th Feb 1991

Address: #62, 1st Main, 8th Cross, Maruthi Nagar, Yelahanka, Bengaluru - 560064
